# Events

Every state change writes an audit event and an outbox row in one transaction (§B9.3). The outbox
row's `payload` is the flat JSON object listed here. The worker dispatches each event to its
subscribers, which is how a notification is produced.

## Events an automation rule can react to

A rule's `when` names one of these; its `if` conditions and recipient references may use only the
fields listed. `holder` names the field that identifies the member the notice is about, when the
event has one. Fields marked personal are left out of an outbound payload unless the installation
allows personal data.

| Event | Fields | Holder | Personal fields |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `location.created` | `code`, `id`, `parent_id`, `path` | none | none |
| `location.deleted` | `code`, `id` | none | none |
| `location.moved` | `id`, `new_parent_id`, `new_path`, `old_path` | none | none |
| `location.updated` | `id`, `name`, `type` | none | none |
| `org_unit.archived` | `code`, `id` | none | none |
| `org_unit.created` | `code`, `id`, `parent_id`, `path` | none | none |
| `org_unit.moved` | `id`, `new_parent_id`, `new_path`, `old_path` | none | none |
| `org_unit.updated` | `id`, `name`, `type` | none | none |
| `team.archived` | `code`, `id` | none | none |
| `team.created` | `code`, `id`, `name`, `type` | none | none |
| `team.updated` | `id`, `name`, `type` | none | none |
| `team_member.added` | `id`, `member_id`, `team_id`, `team_role` | `member_id` | none |
| `team_member.removed` | `member_id`, `team_id` | none | none |
| `team_member.updated` | `id`, `member_id`, `team_id`, `team_role` | none | none |

## Events published by the notification module

Not available to automation rules. Secret values are never in a payload.

| Event | Aggregate | Fields | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `notification.read` | `notification` | `id` | A member marked one of their notices read. |
| `notification.read_all` | `notification` | `count` | A member marked all their unread notices read. |
| `notification_channel.disabled` | `notification_channel` | `allow_personal_data`, `allowed_hosts`, `channel_key`, `display_name`, `enabled`, `id`, `secret_fields_set`, `settings`, `version` | An admin (or the platform admin) switched a channel off: the kill switch. |
| `notification_channel.enabled` | `notification_channel` | `allow_personal_data`, `allowed_hosts`, `channel_key`, `display_name`, `enabled`, `id`, `secret_fields_set`, `settings`, `version` | A channel was switched back on. |
| `notification_channel.installed` | `notification_channel` | `allow_personal_data`, `allowed_hosts`, `channel_key`, `display_name`, `enabled`, `id`, `secret_fields_set`, `secrets_changed`, `settings`, `version` | An admin installed a channel. Secret values are never in the payload, only the names that are set. |
| `notification_channel.updated` | `notification_channel` | `allow_personal_data`, `allowed_hosts`, `channel_key`, `display_name`, `enabled`, `id`, `secret_fields_set`, `secrets_changed`, `settings`, `version` | An admin changed a channel installation. |
| `notification_delivery.dead_lettered` | `notification_delivery` | `attempts`, `channel_key`, `delivery_id`, `error_code` | A delivery used its last attempt or failed in a way retrying cannot fix. |
| `notification_delivery.requeued` | `notification_delivery` | `attempts`, `channel_key`, `status` | An admin sent a dead-lettered delivery again. |
| `notification_preferences.changed` | `member` | `changes`, `member_id` | A member changed their notification preferences. |
